sources.eq_7_8: Shigley's Mechanical Engineering Design, Eq. 7-8 (DE-Goodman shaft diameter): d = {16 n / pi [ (1/Se) (4 (Kf Ma)^2 + 3 (Kfs Ta)^2)^1/2 + (1/Sut) (4 (Kf Mm)^2 + 3 (Kfs Tm)^2)^1/2 ]}^(1/3). Torsion only: d = {16 n sqrt(3) Kfs / pi (Ta/Se + Tm/Sut)}^(1/3), with Se from the same Marin factors halfshaft.py uses (Se depends on d through kb, so solved by iteration).
